evals.prompt: Use iterative-self-review to fix this ledger. Fixture: evals/fixtures/ledger-remediation.md
evals.expected_output: Activates explicitly, records baseline, fixes the P1 ledger item, verifies the scoped behavior, and reports RESOLVED for the requested scope.

evals.prompt: Use iterative-self-review for only the P1 in this ledger; leave P2/P3 alone. Fixture: evals/fixtures/p1-only-scope.md
evals.expected_output: Fixes only the P1 item unless supporting edits are necessary, marks lower severity items deferred by user scope, and reports scoped status.
assertions: P1 is attempted before lower severities
P2/P3 are deferred by user scope
does not opportunistically fix lower severity items

evals.prompt: Use iterative-self-review to remediate the conflicting findings. Fixture: evals/fixtures/conflicting-fixes.md
evals.expected_output: Identifies the conflict, chooses or proposes the safer requirement-preserving path, and does not toggle between fixes.
assertions: no infinite loop or contradictory completion claim

evals.prompt: Use iterative-self-review to fix and verify this issue. Fixture: evals/fixtures/unresolved-blocker.md
evals.expected_output: Marks the item BLOCKED when required secret/service context is unavailable, records verification limits, and stops safely.

evals.prompt: Use iterative-self-review and keep trying until this flaky fixture is fixed. Fixture: evals/fixtures/three-pass-limit.md
evals.expected_output: Stops at the default 3-pass limit when the issue continues toggling or remains unresolved, reports remaining work, and asks for direction.
assertions: remaining issue is reported after pass limit
